# Glimshelf

[Glimshelf](https://glimshelf.com) is a native comic, manga, PDF, and EPUB reader for iPhone and iPad with built-in Kavita support. It connects directly to the Kavita API for library browsing, downloads, and reading-progress sync.

## Installation

1. Download Glimshelf from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/glimshelf/id6802456311/). It requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later and Kavita 0.9.0.2 or later.
2. Open the app and choose **Kavita** during setup.

## Setup

### Get your Auth Key

1. Sign in to your Kavita server in a web browser.
2. In **User Settings**, find the Auth Key controls using the linked Kavita instructions below.
3. Create a named Auth Key for Glimshelf and copy it. Choose an expiration suitable for your use; an expired key must be replaced in the app.

See [Auth Key and OPDS URL](/guides/user-settings/3rdpartyclients/) for Kavita's Auth Key documentation. Treat this key like a password and enter it only into apps you trust.

### Connect Glimshelf

1. Enter your **Server URL**, for example `https://kavita.example.com`. Use the server's base URL, including any configured base path.
2. Choose Auth Key authentication and paste the key into the Auth Key field.
3. Tap **Save** to run the connection check and add the server. If a check fails, Glimshelf shows which step needs attention so you can fix it and try again.

Glimshelf also offers username/password authentication and a Kavita OPDS URL option in the Kavita connection form. The OPDS URL option extracts the server address and key to establish an API connection; it does not switch the Kavita source to OPDS browsing. Generic OPDS catalogs can be added as a separate source type.

Use an address reachable from your iPhone or iPad. For remote access, use HTTPS or your private VPN connection. Your Kavita account's permissions still apply.

## Reading and progress sync

Glimshelf supports browsing Kavita libraries, reading lists, and Want to Read, with reading-progress synchronization back to Kavita. Image-based books support left-to-right, right-to-left, vertical scrolling, and double-page layouts; Local DRM-free EPUB books use a separate EPUB reader. For details on supported sources and formats, see [Glimshelf compatibility](https://glimshelf.com/compatibility).

Download books before going offline and wait for the downloads to finish. Offline reading progress is queued for synchronization when the server is reachable again. If the device and server have different saved progress, Glimshelf can present a choice of where to resume.

## Free and Pro

<Callout type="info">
  **Connecting to Kavita does not require Pro.** Free includes unlimited connected servers, library browsing and search, reading, and progress sync through the native Kavita connection, including progress queued offline. Free keeps up to five downloaded server books across all sources at a time, including books in Trip Packs. Local files do not count toward this limit.

  Glimshelf Pro is optional. It removes the limit on retained server downloads and adds features such as Comic Book List (CBL) import and export, and Bubble Zoom. See [Glimshelf Free & Pro](https://glimshelf.com/#pricing) for details.
</Callout>

## Support

For Glimshelf-specific questions, use **Settings → Support** or the [Glimshelf support guide](https://glimshelf.com/guide#feedback). Include your Glimshelf and Kavita versions and steps to reproduce the issue. Do not include passwords, Auth Keys, or OPDS URLs containing keys.
